sources.title: azeddinShr/Spark-TTS-Arabic · Hugging Face
sources.snippet: Arabic Spark-TTS Fine-tuned on ClArTTS Fine-tuned LLM component of Spark-TTS on ClArTTS Arabic dataset (12 hours of Classical Arabic speech). Model Description This is the fine-tuned LLM (Qwen2) component of Spark-TTS, trained on the ClArTTS dataset. Usage Replace the LLM checkpoint in the original Spark-TTS model with this fine-tuned version.

sources.title: GitHub - SparkAudio/Spark-TTS: Spark-TTS Inference Code
sources.snippet: Spark-TTS is an advanced text-to-speech system that uses the power of large language models (LLM) for highly accurate and natural-sounding voice synthesis. It is designed to be efficient, flexible, and powerful for both research and production use.
